title: Conditions on Which a Car Rental Rate Class May Be Sold
content:
These are the conditions on which a rental may be sold under the Car Rental Rate Classes, and the charges
that attach to the branches and the border it is sold for. Each class's own figures are published in its
schedules.

1. A rate class may only be sold where the rental length falls between its minimum and maximum days and
   where the main driver's age falls within its accepted range.
2. A driver below the rate class's young driver age is accepted only against the class's young driver fee
   for every rental day, and a driver aged seventy or over against its senior driver fee.
3. A driver outside the accepted age range is refused outright.
4. A rental returned to a branch other than the collection branch carries the class's one-way fee.
5. A vehicle taken across an international border is permitted only on a class that allows it and against
   that class's cross-border fee.
6. Collection at an airport branch adds the class's airport surcharge to the rental total, and the vehicle
   licensing recovery fee is charged for every rental day whatever the branch.
7. The agency service fee is charged once per rental when the supplier confirms, and is never charged twice
   because the booking was modified.
8. A rental booked but never confirmed by the supplier binds nobody and is released without charge.

## How conditions 1 to 3 work together

Age is tested twice and against two different figures. The first test is the accepted range, and a driver
outside it is refused; the second is the young driver age, and a driver inside the accepted range but below
that age is accepted with the per-day charge attached. A driver aged seventy or over is likewise accepted
with the senior charge attached, so long as the class's oldest accepted age is not passed.

| Main driver | Inside the class's accepted age range | Below the class's young driver age | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| below the youngest accepted age | no | yes | refused outright |
| inside the range and below the young driver age | yes | yes | sold, with the young driver fee for every rental day |
| inside the range, aged seventy or over | yes | no | sold, with the senior driver fee for every rental day |
| inside the range, neither below the young driver age nor aged seventy or over | yes | no | sold, with no driver fee under this head |

## The service fee and the surcharge

The agency service fee is a charge for the rental and not for each change to it; a rental changed twice
still carries it once, and it falls due when the supplier confirms. The airport surcharge is a percentage
added to the rental total and turns on the branch of collection alone, while the licensing recovery is a
charge for every rental day and turns on nothing.
